_readme: Demo overlay: repairs the alien-format bundle in samples/alien/.
This is what a model is expected to produce when preflight reports FAILED,
and selftest.py uses it to prove the repair path works end to end.
See references/90-when-scripts-fail.md for the procedure that produces a file like this.
os_patterns: Vendor kernel wording for reclaim pressure - the same meaning as 'page allocation stalls'.
Vendor kernel wording for a hung task - the process was blocked, almost always on I/O.
